summary: Available in three sizes — 50cm, 60cm and 80cm — with a refined projection of just 365mm, Bahia is perfectly suited to powder rooms and ensuites. Crafted in Italy by Hatria Ceramica, it embodies precision and elegance in equal measure.
title: New Bahia Basins - Bold Lines, Subtle Details
bodyHtml:
Balance. Proportion. Presence.

Crafted in Italy by Hatria Ceramica, the new Bahia series brings confidence and utility to the modern wash area.

With its defined rectangular profile and generous width, Bahia balances visual strength with refined detail, making it an ideal choice for contemporary interiors.

(original product details unavailable)


Bahia 60 - 600 x 365 x 160 mm

Versatility Across Projects

Available for both bench or wall-mounted installation, Bahia comes in 50cm, 60cm and 80cm widths, meaning it adapts seamlessly to a wide range of project briefs.

Bahia’s 365mm projection also makes it ideal for use in bathrooms where space is limited.


Bahia 50 - 500 x 365 x 160 mm - Optional Towel Rail available for Wall Hung installations

Form & Function - In Harmony

Bahia integrates a discreet overflow and subtle tap landing for everyday usability. Inside the bowl, a gentle curve guides water elegantly to waste—delivering both visual clarity and enduring functionality.


Bahia 80 Wall Hung Basin - 800 x 365 x 160 mm

A Refined Solution

With clean lines, balanced proportions, and a distinctly architectural presence, Bahia is designed to elevate the bathroom as both a functional fixture and a statement piece.
